_comment: The porting ledger. Each key is a WinSCP translation unit (path stem under
status  - done | partial | replaced | na | todo
targets - files in THIS repository carrying the behaviour. A target that
does not exist is reported as broken and counts as zero.
Never mark a unit done to move on. See docs/porting-mandate.md.

core/Configuration.note: Store, atomic writes, defaults. INI import/export still to do.

core/SessionData.note: Full option model, session URL parse/generate for every protocol, raw settings, INI and PuTTY import. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/Security.note: Credential protection, master password, and WinSCP's own password obfuscation format so imported sites actually work.

core/Cryptography.note: AES-GCM + scrypt for our storage; WinSCP's AES file encryption (contents and filenames).

core/HierarchicalStorage.note: JSON store replaces INI/registry hierarchy; INI compatibility layer pending.

forms/NonVisual.note: All 301 actions are registered and reachable from the running app: 296 have a working handler, 5 are declared unavailable with a reason the UI shows. 79 shortcut-carrying actions over 52 combinations, one conflict WinSCP itself has.

core/SftpFileSystem.note: SFTP over ssh2: auth, tunnels, proxies, listing, transfers with resume. Bug-workaround matrix still to verify against a real server.

core/ScpFileSystem.note: SCP over the shared SSH transport, with listing-command parsing.

core/SecureShell.note: Transport, host-key verification and keepalives live with the SSH adapter.

core/FtpFileSystem.note: FTP/FTPS over basic-ftp; MLSD and multi-dialect LIST parsing covered by tests.

core/WebDAVFileSystem.note: Hand-written client; PROPFIND parsing and RFC 7616 Digest auth covered by tests.

core/S3FileSystem.note: Hand-written SigV4 verified against published AWS vectors; multipart, paging, AssumeRole. No live endpoint tested yet.

core/NeonIntf.note: neon (the C WebDAV/HTTP library WinSCP links) is replaced by a hand-written client on node:http/https.

core/Http.note: HTTP plumbing lives with the two protocols that need it.

core/FileMasks.note: WinSCP mask syntax including size and time masks, with a test table.

core/Queue.note: Parallel transfers, pause/resume, throttling, overwrite queries.

core/CopyParam.note: Transfer parameters declared and applied by the queue.

core/FileOperationProgress.note: Byte/file counters, throughput and ETA reporting.

forms/FileFind.note: The non-modal Find window streams results over fs:find and reveals a hit in the panel. ipc.js drops grep/maxDepth/limit, so the renderer re-filters and says which results it could not verify.

windows/SynchronizeController.note: Comparison checklist across all direction/mode/criteria combinations, DST handling, keep-up-to-date watching.

core/Terminal.note: Operation lifecycle, delete/rename/move with their real confirmations and refusals, retry/skip/abort, directory cache, recursive properties, size calculation. The transfer half is now transfer.js: CopyToRemote/CopyToLocal, Source/Sink and their robust reconnect loops, DirectorySource/SinkFile, CreateTargetDirectory, UpdateSource/UpdateTargetAttrs/UpdateTargetTime, TCollectedFileList, TParallelOperation and the full overwrite decision (EffectiveBatchOverwrite/ConfirmFileOverwrite/CheckRemoteFile), which queue.js now calls instead of its own simplified copy. transfer.js moves no bytes itself — queue.js supplies the byte mover — so there is one decision maker and one transfer engine.

windows/TerminalManager.note: Multiple sessions, reconnect policy, verification callbacks.

windows/EditorManager.note: Internal and external editor lifecycle with upload-on-save.

forms/Glyphs.note: Embedded PNG bitmap sheet (7,981 lines, ~90% pure hex; the .cpp behind it is 14 lines). Material Symbols replace it — the action-to-icon mapping is iconFor() in commands.js.

forms/Glyphs120.note: 120 DPI variant of the same bitmap sheet. A vector icon set has no DPI variants, so the four sheets collapse into one mapping.

forms/Glyphs144.note: 144 DPI variant of the same bitmap sheet.

forms/Glyphs192.note: 192 DPI variant of the same bitmap sheet (9,123 of 9,916 lines are pure hex).

forms/Animations96.note: Embedded animation frame bitmaps. M3 motion is expressed in CSS, so frame sheets are not transcribed.

forms/Animations144.note: 144 DPI animation frame bitmaps (15,747 of 18,155 lines are pure hex).

windows/Setup.note: Shortcuts, search path, file associations, winscp:// registration, uninstall cleanup. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/Tools.note: Application helpers. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/WinMain.note: Maintenance-switch dispatch with CheckSafe, the send-to-another-instance decision, the launch usage counters and the startup sequence recorder. main.js owns the Electron lifecycle; the console/scripting modes belong to consolerunner.js.

dragext/DragExt.note: A COM shell extension cannot exist in Electron; the drop-to-Explorer INTENT is implemented via startDrag with a real temp file. The difference is recorded in docs/protocol-gaps.md.

putty/putty.note: Directory-level replacement is recorded separately, not per unit.

filezilla/filezilla.note: Directory-level replacement is recorded separately, not per unit.

forms/About.note: About.dfm rendered with the release code name and its bundled photo; reachable from F1 and the title bar. The registration box is absent by design (this build has none) and the Help button has no target yet.

forms/Authenticate.note: Password, passphrase, account, keyboard-interactive, 2FA, host-key and TLS verification, with a changed host key given its own refusal path. LogView and the per-session remember checkbox are not built.

forms/Cleanup.note: Cleanup.dfm checked list with a real count per row and real removals. The Login dialog still carries its own smaller Clean Up.

forms/Console.note: Modeless console over session:exec with capability gating, scrollback, history and search. No interrupt channel exists, and event:console carries no session id so two open consoles cannot be told apart - both are main-process gaps.

forms/Copy.note: The copy dialog is what every transfer action now opens, and its result is queued through one path. Confirm transfers is honoured; the named preset reaches queue:add.

forms/CopyLocal.note: Same-side copy/move is a target-path prompt in the command layer, not CopyLocal.dfm own form.

forms/CopyParamCustom.note: The transfer-settings frame, rendered from the shared descriptor table.

forms/CopyParamPreset.note: Preset list, preset editor and the four-mask autoselection rule.

forms/CopyParams.note: All 30 TCopyParamType keys have a control, asserted exhaustively by test/preferences.test.js.

forms/CreateDirectory.note: Name, attributes with the rights frame, use-same-settings-next-time, and a real mkdir plus chmod. Help button absent.

forms/Custom.note: replaced: openModal() is the one modal primitive the shell offers.

forms/CustomCommand.note: The command editor with the full pattern reference, a live preview from main own expansion, and a validator faithful to ValidatePattern. It still reports the shipped interactive commands as valid where main rejects them, because ipc.js validates before resolving the interactive pass.

forms/CustomScpExplorer.note: The shared explorer behaviour: panels, selection, the command layer over all 301 actions, both menu bars, the bands and the status bars.

forms/EditMask.note: The four memos, the recursion shortcut, the live composed mask and a validation-only port of the grammar cross-checked against design/main/masks.js.

forms/Editor.note: Modeless editor with find/replace from one RegExp, six encodings, word wrap, go-to-line and a working conflict path. No undo/redo toolbar buttons (execCommand is deprecated) and the remote-changed path is unverified against a live server.

forms/EditorPreferences.note: The ordered editor list with add/edit/remove/reorder and a live first-match-wins probe.

forms/FileSystemInfo.note: Protocol, capabilities and space, rendered from session:fsInfo so the greyed-out commands and this list are one object read twice. Full certificate is not built.

forms/FullSynchronize.note: Direction, mode, criteria, masks and transfer settings, with forbidden combinations refused in words before the call. Timestamp options are greyed from caps. The OK split menu and the transfer-settings button are not built.

forms/GenerateUrl.note: Every scheme, four script formats and three .NET languages; the password is never emitted.

forms/ImportSessions.note: Six real parsers: PuTTY/KiTTY .reg, FileZilla XML, OpenSSH config, WinSCP INI and known_hosts.

forms/InputDlg.note: replaced: promptText() and confirm() in the command layer are the shell input prompts.

forms/License.note: The repository LICENSE rendered byte-identically with search, match navigation and export. No test guards the embedded copy against drift yet.

forms/LocationProfiles.note: Shared and per-site profiles with folders, reordering and keyboard shortcuts that ui/wiring.js now actually binds.

forms/Login.note: The whole dialog: tree, three search modes, per-protocol visibility, all 33 ActionList entries wired, real session:open and configuration import/export. Four actions delegate and say so; the roughly 250 dfm captions are English only.

forms/MessageDlg.note: Button sets, expandable copyable detail and a never-ask-again bound to a real preference. The route back is only on the registered-dialog path.

forms/OpenDirectory.note: Path box with history and both bookmark sheets, each with its own search bar and regex builder. The shortcuts are bound by ui/wiring.js.

forms/Preferences.note: 28 pages, 207 controls over 207 real keys, live writes through config:setPref one key at a time. 45 of those options are stored and not yet honoured - each says so on its own row, and test/preferences.test.js holds the list to the real consumer scan.

forms/Progress.note: Non-modal progress window with per-file and total bars, a live throughput graph and the speed-limit and once-finished menus.

forms/Properties.note: Three sheets, the multi-selection aggregate, streamed size calculation that can now be stopped, permissions/owner/group with recursion and per-file checksums. The S3 tag sheet stays hidden because no adapter exposes tagging.

forms/RemoteTransfer.note: Duplicate/Move on ONE session, queued as a server-side copy. Another session is listed and refused with the reason: main remote-copy builds both ends from a single session, so a cross-session target would copy the wrong file.

forms/Rights.note: A faithful TRights port - set/unset masks, octal and text round-tripping over all 4096 modes, cycling group buttons and the full right-click menu.

forms/ScpCommander.note: Two-pane Commander with the real filesystem, both menu bars complete (194 of 194 dfm actions), the column sets, the drive tree and the status bars. 33 band buttons and the DropdownCombo split buttons are still missing from the toolbars.

forms/ScpExplorer.note: The single-pane Explorer interface with its own bands and menu bar (146 of 146 dfm actions). The same toolbar gaps as Commander.

forms/SelectMask.note: All four modes with the live which-names-would-this-pick-up preview and the infinite colour picker.

forms/SiteAdvanced.note: All 18 sheets and 134 control descriptors bound to SESSION_DEFAULTS. About 20 of them reach no engine code yet, and the captions are English only.

forms/Symlink.note: Create and edit, hard links gated on caps, and edit really performing remove-then-create with that stated before OK.

forms/Synchronize.note: Keep remote directory up to date as a non-modal watcher with an activity log. main Watcher emits changes/tick while ipc.js forwards change/synchronized, so the change events never arrive.

forms/SynchronizeChecklist.note: The checklist arranged around one question, with per-row overrides only where legal and deletions needing a second explicit yes. Check/uncheck-all, Move and the Calculate and Commands menus are not built.

forms/SynchronizeProgress.note: The comparison progress is reported through the same progress surface rather than its own form.

core/Common.note: String/path/time/size helpers ported as pure logic with tests. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/RemoteFiles.note: File list model, rights (octal/symbolic/partial-selection), symlink resolution, unix and VMS path shapes. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/Script.note: The scripting command set with switch parsing, masks and the exit-code contract. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/ConsoleRunner.note: Batch/non-interactive script driving. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/WinConfiguration.note: Preference set with load/save/defaults and version-upgrade migrations, editor list, custom commands, presets, bookmarks, file colours. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/CustomWinConfiguration.note: Folded into winconfig.js. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/GUIConfiguration.note: Folded into winconfig.js. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

windows/GUITools.note: External-application resolution, parameter expansion, temp-file naming policy, process execution with Windows quoting. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/Option.note: Switch parsing and command-line semantics. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/FileBuffer.note: EOL state machine surviving chunk boundaries, BOM and Ctrl-Z handling. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/FileSystems.note: Capability model derived from the adapters' caps so the two cannot disagree. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.

core/FileInfo.note: Version info for About and the update check. Adversarial verification did not run (the verify agent hit the session limit), so this progress is the implementer's own assessment and is deliberately conservative.
